task: Pick up the apple from the bowl and place it into the bin.

intervals.start: The gripper has not yet grabbed the apple, and its tip is about 3 cm away from the apple.
intervals.end: The gripper closes and has just fully gripped the apple, slightly lifting it up.

intervals.start: The apple is placed on the shelf. The right arm's gripper has not yet grabbed the apple, and its tip is about 3 cm away from the apple.
intervals.end: The right arm's gripper closes and has just fully gripped the apple, slightly lifting it up.

intervals.start: The gripper is holding the apple and moves it to about 3 cm above the bin.
intervals.end: The right arm's gripper releases the apple so that it just lands into the bin.

intervals.label: The gripper grabs the fruit from the bowl.
The gripper grabs the fruit from the shelf.
The gripper places the fruit into the bin.
